Sign in to ADAM

Open the dashboard to sign in, then return here.

Prefer remote to use your GPU computer when available. ADAM keeps local Whisper and your default installed voice as fallbacks. Changes apply to new requests.

Use the service’s base URL ending in /v1, model ID and voice ID. The service must already be installed and running. Speech output must be a 16-bit PCM WAV lasting at most 15 seconds. An explicitly selected library voice always plays locally; choose Default in paging and information settings to use routing.

Status updates after a real speech request. During a remote outage, ADAM uses local speech and tries the remote service again after the cooldown. Home Assistant and weather still require their usual network connections.

Conversation

Use the larger model on your computer when available, with a small model on Adam's head-end as a fallback. Answers are short enough to speak. Home controls and weather use their configured services.
